scope: Android Utility only; preserve sample-manifest implementation and existing Alpha/AAB artifacts

eligibility.source: device current Instant at eligibility check, not store first-acquisition/account identity
eligibility.retention: saved IDs remain after deadline; missing state after deadline does not regrant via store account

storage.save: commit success before publishing ownership/notification; rollback in-memory map on failed commit
storage.billing: not used for free grant; purchased_tiers and other billing_prefs untouched

notification.type: existing acquisition dialog, manual close in every accessibility mode; no timer or explicit focus request
notification.gate: resumed, document-free start screen, no busy operation, tutorial, sheet, dialog, error or picker foreground transition
notification.pending_state: retained in ViewModel for current process; not replayed after process death; ownership is persisted independently
notification.dismissal: clears notification queue only; never removes acquired IDs

detail_ui.entry: version/app info acquired badge card; localized Button role and click label
detail_ui.content: larger image, full name, description, fixed visible close action; capped-height vertically scrollable content
detail_ui.locales: two new keys across all 16 resource variants
detail_ui.support_screen_review: only paid tip products already exist there; no preexisting free Koyomi route. No new purchase-adjacent route introduced.

verification.jvm_ui_conditions: ja/en x portrait320x480dp/landscape640x280dp x fontScale1/2; Native Robolectric graphics; actual TextLayoutResult confirms scale, no ellipsis/height overflow, line bounds, scroll and close access
verification.semantics: JA/EN button role, localized click action, title-description-close semantic order and click/close checked
verification.notification_retention: 10-second virtual time no auto-dismiss; closing then manager recreation at deadline keeps saved ID and does not notify again
verification.storage_tests: real JVM Android SharedPreferences recreation; injected failed commit including already-changed in-memory map rollback; existing purchased tiers preserved
verification.clock_tests: boundary nanoseconds, start inclusive/end exclusive, four zones using injected Clock; no real clock changes
verification.builds: assembleDebug and assembleDebugAndroidTest passed; no installation
verification.intentional_suppression: ApplySharedPref/UseKtx only on saveIds: synchronous commit result and rollback are mandatory; all calls from UI routed through IO

not_performed: No real-device or emulator installation or operation
No actual TalkBack service, speech, gesture focus traversal or device rotation
Native-speaker review of added translations not performed
JVM screenshot capture timed out in this Compose/Robolectric combination; not marked passed; UI acceptance uses native text layout and semantics instead
distribution: Source only. Version remains 1.2.14 (30), existing signed AAB unchanged. New policy is not retroactively present in delivered Alpha30.
